question: What does the Comfort Club membership include?
html:
The membership terms (visits, discounts, priority scheduling, price) are not in the material we have, so we can't list what the membership includes without guessing. Here is what we do know and what would answer the question.

What the data covers

  • The data treats membership as a growth driver. It does not describe the plan itself (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
  • Membership growth plus AI answering and booking are expected to add about 10-12% organic growth in the first year (est.) (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).
  • Members today are about 0.9% of core owner-occupied homes (est., an assumption, not a count) (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).

All member figures are planning assumptions (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).

Why scope questions matter

  • We run One Hour, Ben Franklin and Mister Sparky (heating and cooling, plumbing, electrical) in 25 territories (Punctual Pros public filings). Whether one membership covers all three trades is not stated.
  • 45-64% of homes in our core counties were built before 1980 (Punctual Pros market profile). Older systems need more upkeep.
  • About 241k core Pennsylvania households heat with oil or propane. That includes 44.5% in Perry and 37.6% in Lebanon (Punctual Pros market profile). Whether oil and propane equipment is covered is not stated.

Data that would answer it

  • The current membership terms sheet: price, included visits per year, discounts and priority-service rules.
  • Which trades and equipment types are covered, by brand.
  • Active member count from the field-service system, to replace the 6,500 estimate.
  • Renewal and cancellation rates.

Membership is the recurring-revenue line that the growth plan relies on, and its terms set how much each tune-up visit converts into repair and replacement work. Growing from roughly 6,500 to 32,000 members is a large part of the path to about $100M in revenue (est.) (Punctual Pros nationwide plan).

Next actions

  1. Pull the current membership terms and publish a plain-language benefits list on the website so this assistant can answer directly.
  2. Replace the 6,500 member assumption with an actual count and renewal rate from the field-service system.
  3. Confirm whether one membership spans all three trades and whether oil and propane equipment is covered. Decide this before pushing into Berks and Lebanon.
  4. Add a membership offer to the AI booking and missed-call text-back flows, and track enrolment from each.
